board: Cytron MD10C R3.0 10Amp 5V-30V DC Motor Driver (13 A continuous; control header 1 GND, 2 PWM, 3 DIR; POWER and MOTOR screw terminals)
reason: Modelled as an actuator with PWM and DIR inputs. The driver follows Cytron's sign-magnitude truth table: PWM low brakes, PWM high with DIR low runs forward, PWM high with DIR high runs in reverse; it uses 10 kHz PWM, under the 20 kHz limit. POWER+ takes an external 5-30 V supply. The part check passed on the first run on ESP32 and Pico, covering spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, PCB DRC and footprint.
